name: Flip-flop (thonged flat sandal)
definition: flat sandal held only by a toe post between the first two toes and the strap that runs from it to the sides of the sole, with no other strap across or round the foot.
notes: Page shows toe-thong flat sandal sold as flip-flop (Havaianas Top, OluKai Ulele)

name: Slide
definition: backless sandal with a band or straps over the front of the foot.
notes: Slides sold as backless sandal with band over the instep

name: Flat strap sandal
definition: flat sandal held by straps across or round the foot, including one that adds a toe loop or toe post to a strap across the foot (T-strap).
notes: Strappy, T-bar and fisherman sandals listed as flat strap forms

name: Heeled or wedge sandal
definition: sandal on a heel or wedge.
notes: Wedge sandals sold as category; high-heeled sandal listed

name: Sports and outdoor sandal
definition: sandal with adjustable straps on a treaded sole.
notes: Sport sandals category with Teva, Chaco, Keen on treaded soles

name: Gladiator sandal
definition: flat or low sandal with multiple straps up the foot or leg.
notes: Grecian sandal also called gladiator-style: interlaced straps over toes, instep, ankle

name: Woven leather sandal (huarache)
notes: Mexican sandal with woven-leather upper; must be handmade to count

name: Raised wooden sandal (geta)
definition: sandal on a raised wooden base with teeth.
notes: Geta: wooden base with teeth (ha) and thong; sold as geta

name: Closed slipper
notes: Closed-back slippers sold as a style beside mules, moccasins and boots

name: Open (backless) slipper
notes: Backless scuff slippers and slide slippers sold

name: Slipper boot
definition: soft boot without a rigid outsole.
notes: Slipper boots and bootie slippers sold as a category

name: Overshoe and galosh
definition: waterproof covering worn over a shoe.
notes: Overshoes worn over a shoe; rubber work overshoes and cycling overshoes

name: Spat
definition: cloth or leather covering for the instep and ankle worn over a shoe.
notes: Spats cover instep and ankle over a shoe; sold as button, snap and piper spats

name: Shoelace.
notes: Waxed cotton shoelaces sold flat and round in lengths by eyelet count

name: Removable insole, non-medical.
notes: Leather and cushion insoles sold as accessories

name: Heel grip.
notes: Self-adhesive suede heel grips (Mysole) sold as accessory

name: Shoe tree.
notes: Cedar and wooden shoe trees sold by pair, sized

name: Shoe horn.
notes: Horn shoe horns sold in several lengths
